summary: Comprehensive architecture and implementation plan to elevate ShadRox into a frontier-grade desktop AI engineering workspace. Covers: (1) Background autonomous agent team execution with structured final summary reports; (2) Intelligent multi-model routing by task complexity with live streaming thought traces; (3) Advanced multi-tab and split terminal UX with PTY output resilience; (4) Visual hunk-by-hunk Git source control staging; and (5) CodeMirror editor diagnostics and breadcrumbs.
